events.description: Two individuals engage in mutual grappling and dynamic physical struggle: they push, lift, and rotate while both remain on their feet and actively resist (f0–f7).

verification.reason: Frames f0–f7 show reciprocal engagement—both persons are upright, moving, and counter-maneuvering; no clear dominance or helplessness yet, satisfying the definition of fighting (mutual physical combat). The event ends at f7 (3.5 s) when one begins to lose balance and fall.

events.description: After one person falls (f8), the other maintains control, pinning and straddling the downed individual who lies prone and shows minimal resistance (f8–f20).

verification.reason: From f8 onward, the person in white is dominant and the person in dark is on the ground, largely passive; sustained aggression against a non-resisting, helpless individual meets the definition of abuse. Candidate 1 (4.0–6.9) and candidate 3 (7.9–11.5) both fall within this continuous abusive phase, so merged. Note: f9–f12 are blurry/occluded but consistent with continuation; f13–f20 confirm ongoing restraint.
